primer: DigitalOcean (NYSE: DOCN) accelerated Q3 2026 revenue 40% YoY to $321.2M on $376M in AI Customer ARR (+288% YoY). However, GPU infrastructure compressed GAAP gross margin to ~50.1% and pushed combined capex and equipment financing to $266.7M in FY2025, keeping normalized ROIC at 7%–9%. At $86.32 (9.41x FY26E sales), the stock sits in a Weinstein Stage 4 downtrend (-31.96% below its 30W SMA) inside a Correction market, so new capital is REJECTED (TIER_0). We stage an EXIT_ON_BOUNCE on all 78.065338 held shares ($98.00 / $112.90, $78.00 hard stop) and redeploy 50% into Stage 2 MSFT and 50% into Cash.
